Field.Label: Discovery:
Field.Description: Continuously discover Gen2–Gen4 Shelly devices. Create Indigo devices from the Shelly plugin menu.

Field.Label: Additional hosts:
Field.Description: Optional comma-separated IP addresses or hostnames for devices on other subnets.

Field.Label: Event Log level:
Field.Description: Info shows normal activity, warnings and errors. Debug also shows discovery and query messages. Applies immediately; the plugin log file always includes Debug.

Field.Label: Lost device notification delay (seconds):
Field.Description: Wait 0–86400 seconds after detecting a failure before logging it. Recovery within this period suppresses both loss and recovery messages. 0 logs immediately. Offline states update immediately. Applies without restarting.

Field.Label: Beta: switches, dimmers, binary/button inputs and output metering. Set local passwords in each device’s configuration. Restart after changing connection preferences. Logging preferences apply immediately.
